proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10648 raśmi gives Punjabi rassī/rassā rope, a family transmitted into several Indo-Aryan languages, and Western Pahari rośśo rope. The survey rasso/rośi shapes match these regional variants; the precise intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing route remains open. Exact survey form roʃi is preserved.
